title: Big Benaben Dollard. Big Benben. Big Benben.
html_source: Gilbert p224 : ‘There is an obvious final cadence – dominant, tonic (twice repeated) – in 'Ben Benaben. Big Benaben. Big Benaben’.'

anchor.text: Big Benaben Dollard. Big Benben. Big Benben.
anchor.prefix:
235

 Ben Dollard bulkily cachuchad towards the bar, mightily praisefed and all big roseate, on heavyfooted feet, his gouty fingers nakkering castagnettes in the air. 

1939#209
anchor.suffix:
Rrr. 

 And deepmoved all, Simon trumping compassion from foghorn nose, all laughing they brought him forth, Ben Dollard, in right good cheer. 

 — You're looking rubicund, Geo
